Production Desk 1.5.11

  • Main Breakdown displays original PDF pages with selectable text, preserving screenplay layout instead of inferring dialogue formatting from extraction.
  • Tag PDF text across pages without resetting scroll, the selected scene, chosen category or text selection. Repeated actor entries keep input focus and existing drafts.
  • Navigate scenes using their imported PDF page references; zoom and read rotated pages locally. Long scripts release offscreen page images while retaining selectable text.
  • Missing originals fall back to unformatted extracted scene text. Image-only pages explain that text selection needs a searchable PDF; typed breakdown entries remain available. No OCR service or script upload is used.
  • Existing breakdowns, reusable elements, schedules, shot lists and portable backups retain their data. App Store and TestFlight submissions are unchanged.
